intent.proves: At least one visible Authentication or Extranet app is placed on an active page.
intent.scope: active UserAuthentication or UserManagementFrontend paragraphs on active, non-deleted pages

bindings.reason: Paragraph search by app system name is not a verified argument of search_paragraphs.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Paragraph p JOIN Page g ON g.PageId = p.ParagraphPageId WHERE p.ParagraphDeleted = 0 AND p.ParagraphShowParagraph = 1 AND g.PageDeleted = 0 AND g.PageActive = 1 AND p.ParagraphModuleSystemName IN ('UserAuthentication','UserManagementFrontend')
